done_when: Close's review and plan reads do not wait for an agent place, and a test run limited to a few named test files does not wait for the test place

findings.body: Raise: Functional — A test command that includes the picker and a full test run takes no test place when the picker selects at most five files. `few_tests` recognizes the picker by substring, so a supported `fast_test` such as `forge test --pytest {base} && pytest tests` is admitted as small even though its second command runs the full suite. Concurrent runs can then exceed the machine's test limit; the ruling says other test commands must still wait.
findings.title: Compound test commands can bypass the test place

findings.body: Raise: Test — The named proof creates only `tests/test_app.py` and checks a one-file run. The ruling defines “a few” as five or fewer picker-selected files. This test would still pass if admission incorrectly stopped at one file or extended beyond five, so it does not prove the stated boundary through `forge test`.
findings.title: Not done: the five-file picker boundary has an end-to-end lane test

why: A 2-minute review waits about 10 minutes for an agent place and a worker's small test run queues for the single test place
